description:
Calhoun Surf N' Skate is a Canadian small business serving the NHL officially licensed apparel market in North America.

We're looking for creators who have a passion for the NHL, maintain a professional reputation, and can create inspired content that resonates deeply with their engaged followers.

As a clothing manufacturer and retailer, we are continually releasing new officially licensed NHL products that are first to the market. Your participation in our program will allow you to stay up-to-date on future releases, giving you the opportunity to align your efforts with our product launch dates.

Welcome to Calhoun Surf N' Skate! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts - last click attribution.

Affiliates may or may not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If customers both click an affiliate link and use an affiliate's coupon code, the affiliate will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Legal disclosures

Depending on your country of residence, you may be legally required to disclosure your relationship with us, and the nature of your product recommendations.

United States (FTC)

United States (FTC PDF Document)

Canada (Competition Act)

Canada (AdStandards.ca)

5. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

6. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

8. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@calhounsurfnskate.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@calhounsurfnskate.com for support.

 

Welcome to Calhoun Surf N' Skate! Thank you for joining our Affiliate program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program as both a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to use the merchant's products or services.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use it in accordance with these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We retain the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole discretion. In the event that your Affiliate Program Registration is rejected, please note that there are no available legal remedies or avenues for recourse against us.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later clicks on yours, your link will be credited with the referral (last click attribution).

Affiliates may or may not be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage explained in the Dashboard. If customers both click an affiliate link and use an affiliate's coupon code, the affiliate will not receive double commission. Please also note that if you are not assigned a branded coupon, you are not permitted to promote that coupon.

3. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will receive a commission calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount depends on the order value and does not include extra fees (taxes, shipping costs, etc.).

To receive a commission, you need to provide your payment details in the Settings. The payment schedule will be communicated on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be made for completed transactions. The use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which allows the merchant to review each referral order. Commission statuses are displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not be eligible for payment.

4. Marketing Tools

We may provide promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or obtain the HTML embed code to share on your affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If a downline affiliate generates orders for the merchant, the upline affiliate will also receive a network commission based on the merchant's settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link, and any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track individuals who have clicked on your link, so they need to have cookies enabled for us to track their activity.

If a person does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we are unable to track them and cannot pay earnings based on their activity.

The cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking period starts from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie duration, every order made by that customer on the merchant's website will automatically result in commissions for the affiliate (there is no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Removal from the Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@calhounsurfnskate.com.

We wish you the best of luck. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, please email info@calhounsurfnskate.com for support.
